identity.name: The Wall Street Journal
identity.description: An American business and financial newspaper with global news, markets, opinion and investigative reporting.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by Dow Jones & Company, a division of News Corp. The Murdoch-family-controlled parent has substantial influence over editorial strategy, especially opinion.

editorialOrientation.evidence: News and opinion are formally separate; the newsroom has strong reporting standards, while the opinion page is consistently right-of-centre and owner-influenced.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Right-Center and Mostly Factual; news coverage is business-oriented and opinion is pro-market.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business and opinion coverage consistently favour markets, lower taxes and deregulation, with a strong investor audience.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames policy through US business and market interests, with a generally hawkish view of geopolitical risk.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mostly Factual and credibility High; strong newsroom but opinion/selection has a clear pro-market and right-leaning tilt.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Right-Center; factual reporting Mostly Factual; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Business-establishment voice. Explains global events through markets, regulation, corporate strategy and US foreign-policy interests, with a pro-market editorial page.

selectionRationale: Provides a major business/financial perspective and right-of-centre counterweight, though its current public feed is stale.

feeds.validationNote: Last item January 2025; feed is not suitable for current-news ingestion without replacement.

research.researchNotes: Current feed is stale by more than 18 months. Activation recommendation: replace or disable until a current official feed is found. Existing mapping retained. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
